message:
Let me think about this more carefully. The fuzz harness uses `xmlXPtrEval` which evaluates XPointer expressions. The vulnerability is triggered when `id()` is called during XPointer evaluation, and the document contains XInclude elements that get processed, freeing nodes.

Let me look at how XPointer evaluation works and whether XInclude is processed during parsing:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'grep -n "xmlXIncludeProcess\|XInclude" /gt/_work/src/xpointer.c | head -20 && echo "---" && grep -n "xmlXIncludeProcess\|XInclude" /gt/_work/src/parser.c | head -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
